paper.title: RNA neoantigen vaccines prime long-lived CD8+ T cells in pancreatic cancer

methodsContrastWithMelanoma: Unlike the melanoma NeoVaxMI reanalysis (leave-one-out clone expansion and mutation-landscape tallies), this PDAC pass emphasises longevity kinetics: bootstrap CIs, Wilcoxon signed-rank on paired prime/boost half-lives, and Spearman correlation between peak clonal frequency and predicted lifespan.

checks.claim: A large share of primed vaccine clones remain detectable years later (paper reports ~86% of clones per patient at ~3 years).
Post-boost clone half-lives are longer than post-prime half-lives.
checks.metric: Wilcoxon signed-rank on paired half-life differences

checks.claim: Estimated post-boost lifespans commonly span multiple years.
checks.metric: mean post-boost lifespan (years) among modelled clones

checks.claim: A subset of clones has decade-scale estimated lifespans.
checks.metric: count of clones with post-boost lifespan ≥ 10 years

checks.claim: Vaccine-induced CloneTrack clones are largely absent from pre-vaccine tissues.
checks.metric: De novo count in Fig 2g CloneTrack origin panel
